programs.description: Karan, a former soldier, learns that his father committed suicide after being accused of a crime he did not commit. So he sets out to exact revenge on the lawyer who is responsible for his loss.
Three strangers with the same name, Laxminarayan, travel to Pondicherry for their work. However, chaos ensues when they are mistaken for each other as they stay in the same hotel.
A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors is played sequentially.
Akhil and his biker gang participate in races around the city. But he is forced to make some tough decisions after he falls in love with an event manager.
Two meddling friends Bantu and Chantu join a hotel management programme in Goa by pretending to be the owner's nephew and his friend. While training, they expose many employees and guests as frauds.
Rahul falls in love with Sandhya, a fellow college student, but realises that she does not reciprocate his feelings. Undeterred by her rejection, he still pursues her but pays a huge price for it.
Three scorned women unite to dismantle a charming fraudster's deceitful empire, reclaiming their stolen lives through determined vengeance.
A newlywed Kajal gets widowed when her husband, Ravi, is killed by his enemies. She moves to another city and gets married to Raja, but her life takes a turn when Ravi returns from the dead.
A young university student's world is rocked when her brief involvement with a wealthy playboy results in her pregnancy.
A young man adores his three wives and lives in the same building with them. But his facade crumbles when they learn about his fourth bride.
Raju and Urmila fall deeply in love and vow to reunite in India. However, complications arise when Raju agrees to pose as Sharmila's husband before her family.

Raja and Prem, twins separated at birth but connected through reflexes, join forces as adults to take down an underground smuggling kingpin who threatens to destroy their family.

Sargam approaches Raj, a lawyer, to defend her friend Tarang, who is accused of murder. Raj proves that Tarang suffers from split personality but later, he learns that he might be the actual murderer.
Nikhil is a struggling businessman who thinks he is in love with his girlfriend, Karishma, and wants to marry her. Instead, he ends up falling in love with her smart, geeky and quirky sister, Meeta.
A flirtatious photographer juggles three air hostesses behind his fiancée's back. However, the facade unravels when his friend-turned-enemy starts snooping around.
Imprisoned for over two decades, Veer, an Indian Air Force pilot, recounts his love for Zara, a Pakistani girl he rescued in India, as the lawyer tries to uncover the mystery behind his imprisonment.
Bikram and Bala, two best friends and outlaws, fall in love with the same woman causing rivalry between them. A police officer takes advantage of their enmity.
A millionaire businessman living in a village decides to move to the city with his wife. However, things take a comical turn as a case of mistaken identity causes chaos in their lives.

In pre-independence India, six individuals from different families experience the throes of love, betrayal, revenge and depression.
Saloni, a young woman, discovers that she has been impregnated by two men, Akhil and Gurbir. Chaos ensues as the two men compete for Saloni's heart.
Heer, who belongs to a rich family, and Ranjha, a poor farm boy, fall madly in love with each other. But, their lives take a tragic turn when Heer's parents forcibly marry her off to a wealthy man.
Chaos erupt and multiple lives are endangered when the RMS Titanic, a supposedly unsinkable ship, crashes against an iceberg in the Atlantic Ocean.

Against the advice of her friends, Zooni, a visually impaired Kashmiri girl, falls in love with a tourist guide, Rehan. He helps her get her eyesight back, but she remains unaware of his true identity.
A vegetable cutter has his life turned upside down when two strangers from China visit him and claim he is a reincarnation of a war hero.
Sultan Ali Khan's passion for wrestling pushes him to national glory, but the path to redemption and personal peace proves far tougher than any fight in the ring.

When Shekhar falls for Roopa, he approaches her father with his parents. However, when his stepmother asks Roopa's father for dowry, he vows to marry his daughter elsewhere.

A man and a woman come from two feuding families and pretend to be in love for revenge. Their plan goes awry when they fall in love, and they must work on bringing together their families.

Aditya, a heartbroken business tycoon, aimlessly boards a train to escape his depressing life. Soon, he meets Geet, a bubbly Punjabi girl, and gets pulled into her crazy life.

After falling in love with a clumsy girl, a small-time goon comes in contact with his doppelgänger, AJ, before setting off on a romantic journey with his ladylove.

programs.description: A robotics engineer on the quest to find his ideal partner, falls in love with an intelligent female robot mistaking her for a real woman in Los Angeles.
Stepbrothers Aftab and Jai, who loathe each other, must learn to put aside their differences and work together to prove their innocence in a terrorism case.
Ram and Leela fall in love with each other, however, they cannot be together as their families, Rajadi and Sanera, have been at war with each other for the past 500 years.

Om, a junior film artist, is smitten by Shantipriya, a renowned actress, but is killed while trying to save her from a fire accident. Thirty years later, he is reborn and sets out to avenge her death.
After a journalist helps to release him from prison, a man agrees to work as a hitman for her, leading him to entangle with a battle between two drug lords.

Six years after their marriage, a young couple witnesses a brand-new threat that challenges their relationship's integrity and loyalty.
Govinda Waghmare, who is stuck with his controlling wife, seeks love from his gorgeous girlfriend which leads him into a chaotic situation.
Sunil expresses his love for Pinky, and they enjoy each other's company. However, the ones who are against their relationship create misunderstandings between them and that leads to a breakup.
Sameer struggles with anger issues that complicate his personal life and relationships. His world takes an unexpected turn when he meets Rani.
Prem's heart fills with despair when the woman he loves fails to show up for their wedding day. However, his life soon takes an unexpected turn with the arrival of a new neighbour.
After his wealthy family prohibits him from marrying the woman he is in love with, Devdas's life spirals downward as he takes up alcohol and a life of vice to alleviate the pain.
A woman who is blind struggles to come to terms with the apparent death of her first love and a new love who wants to help her move on with her life.
A daring thief partners with an alluring yet untrustworthy woman to steal priceless artefacts. Meanwhile, a trio of determined detectives relentlessly pursues the pair.
